about_the_game:
Steam & Steel — Railway Tycoon puts you in charge of a dieselpunk railway empire running in fast-paced idle/active sessions, straight from your browser—no installs, no loading screens. Coordinate a one-second-per-tick gameplay cycle, speed things up at x2 or x4 when urgency calls, and pause at will to plan every decision in peace. Masterfully manage cashflow, coal, timber, steel, passengers, and reputation while juggling the ever-growing demands of your network.

The campaign challenges you to oversee seventeen routes linking fortresses, skyway hubs, and tourist enclaves. A dynamic grid-based tactical map shows every train in real time, while an airport-style board reports arrivals, departures, and critical news instantly. Build your fleet from the veteran Mk I to the luxurious Zenith Stormliner, assign premium services, schedule maintenance, and upgrade structures like stations, workshops, mines, or customs offices to multiply production.

Recruit specialists with unique bonuses and handle weather shifts, festivals, audits, or unexpected convoys that shake up the game. Open your railway to foreign trade by negotiating tariffs, take out loans with automatic repayment, send out temporary expeditions, and speculate on the railway stock exchange before unlocking legendary projects at the innovation lab. Everything is tracked with autosave, manual snapshots, and JSON export/import to keep your progress safe and shareable.

Key Features

  • Custom pace: one-second tick with adjustable speeds and instant pause for stress-free decisions.

  • Comprehensive resource and reputation management to sustain a constantly expanding rail network.

  • Live tactical map and airport-style board with news ticker so you never miss a detail of your empire.

  • Evolving fleet and upgradable buildings that define each route’s efficiency and services.

  • Specialized staff, dynamic events, and foreign trade to keep every session fresh.

  • Advanced finance, daring expeditions, stock exchange, and innovation projects for the endgame.

  • Autosave, optional snapshots, and JSON export/import to safeguard and share your achievements.
